title: PredictedProfit
description: One row of fct_predicted_profit_24h: a user's predicted 90-day contribution profit, scored from the first 24 hours of behaviour. Estimand: unconditional E[90d profit per exposed user] (payers and non-payers alike). Use it for experiment and bandit readouts, never as an ad conversion value; ad values come from purchase-value-score.schema.json. All money fields are USD in major units. Identity (enforced by validators.ts within 0.01): predicted_profit = predicted_revenue - predicted_generation_cost - predicted_fees - predicted_refund_risk.

predicted_generation_cost.description: Vendor list cost of predicted credit burn (seed: fixtures/seeds/model_costs.csv).

predicted_refund_risk.description: Expected refund + chargeback loss in USD (not a probability).

features.description: Feature snapshot used for the score (flat scalars). Recommended keys are listed in types.ts FeatureSnapshot.
